title: Transcriptome profiling of human anaplastic meningioma IOMM-Lee cells following silencing of HuR (Human antigen R) gene expression by siRNA

publications.title: Cytoplasmic overexpression of RNA-binding protein HuR is a marker of poor prognosis in meningioma, and HuR knockdown decreases meningioma cell growth and resistance to hypoxia.

needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-13), surfaced by the monthly refresh's ArrayExpress/BioStudies keyword_api check, verified directly against the live BioStudies API (title, description, and sample count confirmed exactly). IOMM-Lee is the same well-known anaplastic meningioma cell line already used in other adjacent records in this inventory (e.g. gse-222895-iomm-lee-xenograft-rnaseq.json), so this is a distinct experiment on a shared standard reagent, not a duplicate of any existing record -- confirmed no overlapping accession or identical description. sample_count=12 taken directly from the BioStudies 'Samples' attribute ('Sample count: 12'), a sextuplicate design (6 replicates x 2 conditions: HuR/ELAVL1 siRNA knockdown vs. negative-control siRNA). Despite the title saying 'Transcriptome profiling,' the record's own Study type field is 'transcription profiling by array' (EFO_0002768) -- this is a microarray study, not RNA-seq, hence modality is expression_array, not bulk_rna_seq. Corresponding author and institution taken directly from the record's listed submitter/investigator and organization fields. No linked publication was found via a live Europe PMC search; flagged for a follow-up literature search in a future session rather than left unattempted. FOLLOW-UP PUBLICATION SEARCH (2026-07-13), match found: a Europe PMC keyword search for the corresponding author (Vallar, Luxembourg Institute of Health) combined with 'meningioma HuR' surfaced Gauchotte et al. 2017 (PMID 28493484, J Pathol), whose abstract (fetched directly via PubMed efetch) explicitly states the authors 'examined the anti-proliferative effects of HuR knockdown in two meningioma cell lines (IOMM-Lee and Ben-Men-1) and conducted transcriptome-wide analyses (IOMM-Lee cells) to elucidate the molecular consequences of HuR knockdown' -- an exact design match for this record's siHuR-vs-negative-control IOMM-Lee microarray. Author list includes Vallar L (Proteome and Genome Research Unit, Luxembourg Institute of Health), matching this record's corresponding_author/institution exactly. The paper is closed-access with no PMCID, so the exact accession string E-MTAB-4999 could not be grepped in the full text; the match is based on exact author-institution identity plus an unambiguous design/topic match rather than an in-text accession hit, and is recorded here as such. Publication added; publication_status normal so tags.peer_reviewed set true.
